description: Create public website for ctxman with VitePress, featuring modern responsive design, bilingual support (English/Turkish), documentation integration, interactive demo page, and GitHub integration.
steps: 1. Initialize VitePress in website/ directory at project root with npm init and vitepress installation
2. Create VitePress config (website/.vitepress/config.js) with: navigation, sidebar, i18n for EN/TR, head meta, social links, GitHub integration
3. Create shared theme configuration with custom CSS for modern design, responsive layout, code highlighting, dark/light mode
4. Create English pages: index.md (hero landing page), features.md, getting-started.md, api-reference.md, demo.md (interactive playground), changelog.md
5. Create Turkish pages: tr/index.md, tr/features.md, tr/getting-started.md, tr/api-reference.md, tr/demo.md, tr/changelog.md
6. Create reusable Vue components: FeaturesGrid.vue, CodeDemo.vue, GitHubStars.vue, LanguageSwitcher.vue, InteractiveDemo.vue
7. Integrate existing documentation from docs/content-en/ and docs/content-tr/ into VitePress sidebar and pages
8. Add package.json scripts for website: docs:dev, docs:build, docs:preview
9. Create .github/workflows/website.yml for GitHub Pages deployment with proper permissions and concurrency
10. Add CNAME file and configure for custom domain support (optional placeholder)
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npm run docs:dev' starts VitePress dev server on port 5173
Running 'npm run docs:build' produces static site in website/.vitepress/dist/
All pages are accessible in both English and Turkish
Language switcher works correctly on all pages
Website is responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports
GitHub stars badge fetches and displays live count
Interactive demo page allows basic ctxman functionality simulation
Documentation pages render correctly with syntax highlighting
SEO meta tags present on all pages
verification: npm run docs:build should complete without errors
Open dist/index.html and verify landing page renders
Check that all internal links work correctly
Verify language switching between EN and TR
Test responsive design in browser dev tools (mobile/tablet/desktop)
findings: VitePress website successfully created with all features. Build completed successfully. Minor warning about gitignore syntax highlighting (not critical - falls back to txt). All 1211 project tests still pass. GitHub Pages workflow configured for automatic deployment on pushes to main branch affecting website/ directory.
